title: The specified kappa factors through the coefficient and normalized Roos comparisons
statement: Fix prime ell, finite E/Q_ell, an isomorphism g:X to Y, and assume ell invertible in every stalk of X and Y. Use the regular coefficient models and their actual coefficient comparison c_R: g^{-1}R_Y isomorphic to R_X of [lem-pod-canonical-coefficient-model-maps]. Let kappa be the specified inverseImagePullbackComparison on the regular flat-term K-flat complex with its identity resolution [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Let r be the normalized constantWeilIntegralRoosComparison from completed derived pullback of R_Y to R_X [def-weil-constant-weil-structure]. Then kappa equals c_R.hom composed with r.inv. All maps are the specified maps, rather than an arbitrarily chosen coefficient isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 03D6 and 08TC; the parent coefficient-comparison proof and the proved regular-unit APIs of lean/Sheaf/Paper/ConstantWeilStructure.lean.

proof.text: The chain coefficient isomorphism conjugates the specified augmentation to constantWeilChainUnit by the unit/Roos normalization theorem.

The exact-functor derived/single comparison identifies the localization of this chain coefficient isomorphism, preceded by mapDerivedCategoryFactors, with canonicalCoefficientIntegralComparison. This is the exact single-functor natural-isomorphism identity followed by the inverse actual coefficient unit.

Unfold the specified identity-resolution comparison. Functoriality sends both identity resolution maps to identities. Substitute the chain augmentation equation and localize its composite. The remaining factors are exactly c_R.hom and the inverse normalized Roos comparison, proving the factorization.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientKappa_factor {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y)) :
    canonicalCoefficientKappa l E g hX hY =
      (canonicalCoefficientIntegralComparison l E g).hom ≫
        (constantWeilIntegralRoosComparison l E g).inv
